model_seed_rule: rigidbody uses base+model_index, model_index1..20. flexref sampling_factor1 inherits each input model seed; flexref.iniseed is not an independent refinement-seed control.
fixed_denominator: 6cases x2sourceprofiles x3informationarms x3seeds =108 seed-level workflow cells,36conditions; every source/preparation/prediction failure retained.

box_to_AIR.source: Only the separately frozen box center/full side lengths and independently audited protein coordinates. No native glycan coordinates or native contacts are read.
box_to_AIR.closed_box_rule: Select exactly receptor protein heavy atoms whose absolute coordinate difference from the frozen center is <=side_length/2 in each Cartesian axis.
box_to_AIR.identity: Use verified actual CNS segid,resid,name tuples, sorted deterministically; retain every receptor assembly chain. Glycan segid L with canonical CCD atom keys, and all full-parent heavy atoms.
box_to_AIR.restraint: One OR-union protein atom selection against one OR-union of all glycan heavy atoms; assign (protein_union) (glycan_union) 2.0 2.0 0.0
box_to_AIR.empty_selection: Explicit unavailable workflow cell, no fallback or replacement.
box_to_AIR.interpretation: Coarse site prior through an ambiguous pseudo-distance. It is not a hard Cartesian box and not exact equivalence to Vina's spatial search restriction. Record selected atoms/box/source/AIR SHA per arm.

workflow.ranking: Per-seed individual final HADDOCK score ascending, tie immutable original model number; all models retained and original identities/energies exported. Cluster rank fields null because no clustering.
workflow.failed_models: Retain as explicit failed slots, never replace or extend the20-slot pool.

adaptations_from_released_example: New source-only box-derived union AIR instead of native-contact AIRs
All native-reference caprieval and interface residue lists omitted
All clustering/selection omitted; every surviving initial model refined
Three fixed base seeds and explicit one CPU
interpretation: Small-sampling feasibility comparison, not recommended full HADDOCK sampling, not exact released-example reproduction, not certified unbiased method superiority. Source preparation and restraint representation differences must accompany any later result.
execution: Root must freeze exact source receipts, receptor/source eligibility, boxes, AIR files, configs, seeds, resource budget, model identity and outcome analysis before first cohort docking pose. No background or cohort docking is executed by source-preparation scripts.
retention: Retain every generated rigidbody model, refine every available model with sampling_factor1, retain every refined model and individual score order. No clustering or native/interface selection. Maximum20rigidbody+20refined per seed.
released_example_distinction: Official test20initial models retained12 in its actual native-informed clustering execution. Twelve is an observed count, not a published fixed retention. This new workflow omits clustering and has variable0..20refinements.
accuracy_gate: No pose or site accuracy until all108 method cells terminal and separate external paired-metric report code/plan frozen byroot. Driver computes no accuracy. Root owns foreground execution and resource budget.
